reviews.comment: Great prof!! Can tell he loves his job and very friendly and ready to answer questions. The homeworks and practice exams are exactly like the exams and they're all open note. This class was very new to me but he made it easy to digest.

Lots of homework assignments, but they really prepare you for the test. This class was hard for me, but he enthusiastically answered my million questions. He is eager to help you outside of class and does his best to help you succeed. Great guy!
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: I really liked professor Schulman. ECMT 461 is a hard class, but you can tell he cared and actually wanted to help his students.

Professor Schulman is one of the nicest professors I have ever had before. The class was difficult, with 3 exams, a project, and homework. If you have to take this class take it with Professor Schulman if possible,
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Super nice prof, can tell he cares about the subject. Exams were just like reviews and homeworks. Term project was a little tough but his office hours were very helpful. The lectures were boring at times but they do help with homeworks. Recitations can be hit or miss. Overall he's a great guy and I would definitely take another class with him

You can tell he is passionate about his lectures, some of them are hard to follow especially when you get deeper into the semester, however he gives lots of resources to help you on homework and the open note tests. My only issue was making sure to calculate my grades in aggie gradebook as canvas isn't accurate. Start your term paper early!!!

I loved this class so much! I feel so much more confident in both excel and understanding statistics after taking this course. You can tell Professor Schulman truly loves what he teaches and his students. He is super open to helping and answering HW questions and term project questions. Tests are carbon copies of test review. Very attainable A.

He is extremely knowledgeable. Exams were tough, but open note, so take good notes. It's a required course, but honestly, it helped with other non-econometrics courses. If I could've taken more classes with him, I would have.

Schulman is such a chiller. Super understanding and very willing to help. Homeworks almost every week are simple, the recitations will give you every formula. Open note exams you take from home on lockdown, identical to practice exams. He is the goat

If you don't know a thing about statistics, you definitely have to attend his lectures and pay attention. But other than that, the key to an A in this class is doing the test reviews he posts. His tests are almost carbon copies of the reviews. He also drops the two lowest hw assignments out of 9. Other than that he is one of the best prof here.
Dr. Schulman is one of my favorite professors I have taken at A&M! He is very easy going and willing to help. Would recommend!

This professor cares! The class itself is pretty interesting since he uses examples from the real world unlike most of the ECON department. The tests and HW's are extremely easy since it's all open note (at least when I took it). I would love to have another class with Professor Schulman.

Schulman is the GOAT. He is funny and pretty lenient on grading. He doesn't grade often though, so you may stress about your grade. However, he starts the semester off with saying if you try, you'll get an A or B. Almost everyone I know got an A. There are some group projects though and make sure to make friends in case your code is not working.

He really cares a lot about people and his students in general. He works with you and cares about what you're going through. The coursework seems very complicated but you can get through it. His tests aren't too bad because you can use anything that's a hard copy as a reference. The project is tedious but stay on track and you'll get it done.

He is so good about answering questions and won't let you leave until you are sure about the topic. He's very understanding when it comes to grades that are weighted heavy. He makes it clear that he wants every one in his class to succeed.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Schulman is the best ECON/ECMT professor I have had at TAMU. Lectures are actually engaging and are posted online as well. If you show up with a positive mindset and are engaged you will do well, still the highest grade I have ever gotten in an ECON class to date. TA's for recitation can be hit or miss, but they mostly help with the group project.

Amazing professor. Class seems tough, Schulman makes it super easy. The homework's are easy to do when you go to the recitations. Also the exams are super easy (open notes), if you just practice example problems that he provides. For the project, just follow the guidelines and you will get a 100.Super easy, and not hard work for such course. Easy A
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: All around great proof. Easy layout course, with plenty of homework to master the content for the exam. DO TAKE!!
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Craig is super funny, caring, and a genuine person. Enjoyed his class style, grading, and lectures. Though the class material was confusing, he tried his best to explain it to the full without boring the rest of the class. The TA was bad, but Craig was great!

One of the best professors I have had. Genuinely cares about his students. You can tell he loves what he does. If you are stressing or need extra help he is more than willing! Attendance isn't mandatory, but I would recommend at least going to recitation because they help do the homework. Essay was intense but TA's grade them, not hard graders.

I LOVE Professor Schulman! If you have the opportunity to take his class, do it! He is so caring and will help you as much as he can. He is so encouraging as well. I took 461 and 673 with him and he reminds me why I'm majoring in economics. The class and material are hard, but Schulman makes it easier.

Schulman is a caring and helpful professor. His lectures are too in-depth and not worth sitting through. The TA sessions are extremely important and are where you'll learn what you need to know for the HW and exams. This class is very TA dependent so you may need to go to different recitations to find a good one. He gives good reviews for the exams

This class is not super difficult and Professor Schulman is always willing to help if you have a question. The exams were open note and the homework was really useful for studying for them. There is a long term paper, but parts of it are due throughout the semester, so you can make sure that you are on the right track.

Schulman is great, as he provides enough material to study effectively with great videos. However, this class is HEAVILY TA DEPENDENT, I would turn in the same hw as a friend w a different TA and sometimes grade difference was 10-20 points. They often have a super difficult time understanding you and the material. Project lengthy clear instructions

EMCT 461 sucks but Schulman is easily the best option. Lectures are boring but homework isn't too bad and he will show you step by step how to do the writing project. Also get a cheat sheet on exams and the reviews for them are very similar. There's a reason he's a 4.89 rating.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: ECMT 461 is a hard class, but Schulman does his best to give you the best chance to do well. Exams are straightforward and similar to the homework, so if you study you'll do well. Still a hard a class, but Schulman is a kind and caring professor.

Dr. Schulman is the ideal professor. He goes a little fast in lectures, but he very willing to explain anything you ask him in or outside of class. He does not try and trick you on the exams and gives a study guide on exactly what he expects you to know for the test. The class is hard conceptually, teaches R(Stat program), takes a lot of effort.

This class was difficult especially if you don't have any stats knowledge, but Schulman is there to help you. He is truly there for the students and is such a genuine professor. Tests are rather straight forward and the term paper is alot but if you showed you tried you should be good. Super awesome professor teaching not awesome material.

This was one of the hardest classes I've ever taken, but Schulman himself is a sweet man and will answer any questions. If you don't know how to use Excel you will struggle because the class is very based in Excel. Term project is all about applying excel. TAs are a hit or miss and do all the grading.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: ADORE THIS MAN. Absolute sweetheart, super helpful, not judgy even on the most embarrassing questions. TAs are a mixed bag and do all the grading. He has started giving exams again but they're borderline effortless. Homework is just using Excel (harder than it sounds), and term paper is just using Excel and understanding concepts.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: Schulman is a solid choice for econ 461. Its one of the hardest econ classes but with schulman it wasnt too bad. Homework every week. 2 tests and a term project. The class will be hard no matter who you take, but Schulman is the obvious prof to choose.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: ECMT 461 is just a pretty hard class, but Schulman does a pretty good job with it. He is a lovely guy and loves statistics. The class average on our midterm was like a 54, and he was really torn up about it and felt like he failed us, so he set up tons more office hours and would campout in the Evans Starbucks for like 5 hours a day.

I liked Dr. Schulman. He was good at explaining econometrics and always accessible. He really shows that he cares about his students in the way he helps us understand the material. The whole class is structured around a term paper, which is worth 60% of the grade, and homework being worth 40%. Not too bad of a class, just use office hours for help
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Inspirational--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The first day of class, I went up to Dr. Schulman to ask if I should even take his class - I'm bad at math. "Yes!" He replied. "If you can count to one, you can be a statistics expert." I must have asked Dr. S 1 million questions - I know now that most were dumb - but his genuine care for the material and his students inspired me to work hard.

Professor Schulmann is by far my favorite professor I have ever had. The concept of learning statistics and Microsoft Excel was incredibly intimidating at first, but Professor Schulmann and the TA's were always ready to help explain homework, term project assignments, and other questions we may have had. This has been my favorite class!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Schulman is a gem in the econ department. He truly cares about your success in the class and will literally go out of his way to make sure you understand the material and have a good grasp of the concepts. Although the SAS homework isn't easy, he grades pretty leniently and won't give you anything that wasn't covered on the online lecture videos.

Always love Dr. Schulman. Hes very professional and cares a lot about his students. He will help you in any way possible if he can. By no means an easy class but its probably the most pain free when taught by Schulman. TAKE HIM!

Craig is so nice. Take his class - you will not regret it. He has imparted so much knowledge on me, and he made it so easy for me to make an awesome grade. HW assignments every week that he and his TAs help you with. Midterm exactly like practice problems. Term paper graded so easily, and it was so beneficial to write. Final  easy money.

Professor Craig is awesome! Go to class and to his office hours for any questions and you will be golden. He's very open and receptive to all students that struggles. He really wants you to learn and to pass! The class can be hard based on your knowledge of excel!

Lectures can be hard to follow but he is an easy grader and puts his lecture notes online. He also posts old test questions for practice which are helpful and lets you use a page of notes for each exam! He's a cool guy and very understanding.

3 exams, 9 hws, 1 research paper. Schulman is a great prof: fair & straightforward. I never went lecture and still got A's on the tests, just know how to do the review slides & example problems in the lecture notes & you're golden. HW's are easy. The research paper can be difficult, make sure to give yourself enough time and see the writing TA.

Dr. Schulman is a great professor. If you are good at statistics then it is really easy but if this is your first class the paper can be difficult. His lectures help a lot but he posts all the slides online. Overall, homeworks and tests are very straightforward, he won't try to trick you.
